name: MeshClient
description: A Meshtastic client for your handheld: read and send messages, browse the mesh, and edit your radio's settings over Bluetooth LE or USB.
author: mcereal

changelog.v2.38.0: List, share and withdraw the mesh's shared places; Honour a dated expiry, and let the places follow the radio.
changelog.v2.37.0: Mark a message's delivery state instead of spelling it.
changelog.v2.36.0: Count the roster a running sync has delivered; Gate the radio actions on the link, not on knowing the radio; Stop the client losing a sync it had already earned.
changelog.v2.35.0: The four radio verbs that are not a section; Never let a canned save delete a message it could not show.
changelog.v2.34.3: Close the four truncation sites the device build reports.
